title: nephrolepis biserrata
intro: Nephrolepis biserrata, commonly known as the Sensitive Fern or Hairy Lip Fern, is a species of epiphytic or terrestrial fern in the family Lomariopsidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic agent. The therapeutic actions of Nephrolepis biserrata include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in the plant are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
